concerns.text: FR-008 (distinct random seeds) and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) require a dedicated seed management utility. Task T008 ('Setup deterministic random seed management') is marked incomplete, yet T016 and T023 (training loops) depend on it. Without T008, the statistical variance and reproducibility requirements cannot be satisfied.

FR-008 requires Gaussian noise injection (σ=0.05) into confidence scores. Task T026 ('Implement per-step Gaussian noise injection') is marked incomplete. T016 and T023 explicitly depend on T026. The absence of a completed T026 means the core statistical variance mechanism is missing from the implementation plan.

Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and FR-001/FR-003 require schema contracts for validation. Task T004 ('Create missing schema contracts') is marked incomplete. T007 (validation helpers) and T033 (result validation) depend on T004. The plan blocks downstream validation and data integrity checks.

US-2 (CAP Implementation) requires historical confidence data to calculate mean/variance for pruning. Task T009 ('Implement State Store utility') is marked incomplete. T021 (CAP Classifier) depends on T009. Without the state store, the CAP mechanism cannot access the historical data required by FR-003.

US-3 (Statistical Analysis) requires a batch runner to execute 100 runs (10 tasks x 10 seeds) as per FR-008 and Plan Step 4. Task T031 ('Create batch runner script') is marked incomplete. The plan lacks a mechanism to orchestrate the required statistical distribution generation.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning) requires checksumming artifacts and updating the state file. Task T034 ('Run versioning script') is marked incomplete and depends on T001 (Project Structure), which is also incomplete. The versioning workflow is blocked, violating Principle V.

Task T013 description states 'MUST fail loudly... (NO synthetic fallback)' for MMLU data, while Spec Assumptions state 'if the specific MMLU subset is unavailable, MUST fall back to a synthetic expert distribution'. The task description contradicts the spec's resilience assumption regarding held-out data fallbacks.
